# Variable selection, run end to end

*Generated by `creditsurv select`. Every number comes from this run.*

## What was run

Steps 5 to 9 of `docs/variable_selection.md`, on the training half of the whole
population up to 2024-12, under the `exclude` moratorium policy:
**59,663,961 cells covering 2,345,846,897 loan-months**, with no sampling
at any step.

Two departures from the first run, both to keep the backtest honest. The selection sees
only the training half, because a specification chosen on the months the model is judged
on has already seen the test. And stability is judged across loans originated in even and
in odd years -- two halves that each cover every calendar month -- rather than across the
whole population and its first 94%, which needs the test window.

## Chosen

`fico_s + orig_ltv + dti + term_years + cltv_drift + unemp_gap + nfci_lagged + rate_gap + hpi_growth + policy_rate_gap + inflation + equity_return + sentiment + starts_growth + inflation_gap + C(purpose, Treatment('purchase')) + C(occupancy, Treatment('owner_occupied')) + C(has_mi, Treatment('N')) + C(first_time_buyer, Treatment('N'))`

**Every candidate removed, with the step and the reason**

| covariate | why it was removed |
|---|---|
| credit_spread | step 6: variance inflation 11.9, above 10 |
| term_spread | step 9: 1 sd effect -0.123 on even and +0.004 on odd origination years, beside policy_rate_gap (+0.134), both interest rates |
| vix | step 8: wrong sign: +0.009349 where - is expected |
| vix_gap | step 8: wrong sign: +0.00254 where - is expected |
